listing.name: Guitar Hero II (Xbox 360) — reGH2 (jillsandwich1998)
listing.summary: Early prerelease tested on one computer. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Guitar Hero II (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. USA title 415607E7; XEX SHA1 b90b864487e6291761b207c8d0064e9a0779bdee.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Linux reGH2 AppImage with your own USA ISO or extracted folder. It recompiles locally; generated game code is not shipped.

warnings: Early prerelease tested on one computer.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
